```{r graph-data, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── String & author-name helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────
clean_unicode_punct <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[\u2010\u2011\u2012\u2013\u2014\u2212]", "-", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("[\u2018\u2019\u02BC]", "'", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\u00A0", " ", x, perl = TRUE)
  trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", x))
}

safe_ascii_lower <- function(x) {
  out <- iconv(x, from = "UTF-8", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")
  bad <- is.na(out) & !is.na(x)
  if (any(bad)) {
    out[bad] <- iconv(x[bad], from = "UTF-8", to = "ASCII", sub = "")
  }
  out[is.na(out)] <- ""
  tolower(trimws(out))
}

norm_title <- function(t) {
  t <- clean_unicode_punct(t)
  t <- safe_ascii_lower(t)
  t <- gsub("[^a-z0-9 ]", " ", t)
  trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", t))
}

jaccard_sim <- function(a, b) {
  a <- unique(a[nzchar(a)])
  b <- unique(b[nzchar(b)])
  u <- length(union(a, b))
  if (u == 0) return(0)
  length(intersect(a, b)) / u
}

title_case_if_allcaps <- function(tok) {
  letters_only <- gsub("[^\\p{L}]", "", tok, perl = TRUE)
  if (nchar(letters_only) >= 3 && !grepl("\\p{Ll}", tok, perl = TRUE)) {
    low <- tolower(tok)
    low <- gsub("(^|[-'])(\\p{Ll})", "\\1\\U\\2", low, perl = TRUE)
    return(low)
  }
  tok
}

format_surname <- function(s) {
  s <- clean_unicode_punct(s)
  toks <- strsplit(s, "\\s+")[[1]]
  toks <- vapply(toks, title_case_if_allcaps, character(1))
  res <- paste(toks, collapse = " ")
  # Capitalize after apostrophe in names like Dall'asta -> Dall'Asta
  gsub("(?<=\\p{L}{2}')(\\p{Ll})", "\\U\\1", res, perl = TRUE)
}

given_to_initials <- function(given) {
  given <- clean_unicode_punct(given)
  given <- gsub("[.-]+", " ", given)
  parts <- strsplit(trimws(given), "\\s+")[[1]]
  parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]
  if (length(parts) == 0) return("")
  inits <- vapply(parts, function(w) {
    letters <- gsub("[^\\p{L}]", "", w, perl = TRUE)
    if (!nzchar(letters)) return("")
    if (!grepl("\\p{Ll}", letters, perl = TRUE)) {
      return(letters)
    }
    toupper(substr(letters, 1, 1))
  }, character(1))
  paste0(inits, collapse = "")
}

is_particle_tok <- function(tok) {
  tolower(tok) %in% c("van", "von", "de", "del", "der", "den", "di", "da", "la", "las", "los", "te", "ten", "ter")
}

parse_display_author <- function(name) {
  name <- clean_unicode_punct(name)
  if (!nzchar(name)) return("")
  if (grepl("collaborators|consortium|group|committee", name, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(name)
  }
  words <- strsplit(name, "\\s+")[[1]]
  n <- length(words)
  if (n <= 1) return(name)

  # Walk backwards from the last token to keep surname particles & known compound surnames intact
  surname_start <- n
  while (surname_start > 2) {
    prev <- words[surname_start - 1]
    cur  <- words[surname_start]
    if (is_particle_tok(prev)) {
      surname_start <- surname_start - 1
    } else if (safe_ascii_lower(prev) == "sainz" && tolower(cur) == "de") {
      surname_start <- surname_start - 1
    } else if (safe_ascii_lower(prev) %in% c("galvez", "fernandez", "ramirez", "abreu") &&
               surname_start == n) {
      surname_start <- surname_start - 1
    } else {
      break
    }
  }
  if (surname_start > 2 && safe_ascii_lower(words[surname_start - 1]) == "galvez" &&
      safe_ascii_lower(words[surname_start]) == "sainz") {
    surname_start <- surname_start - 1
  }

  given_str   <- paste(words[seq_len(surname_start - 1)], collapse = " ")
  surname_str <- format_surname(paste(words[surname_start:n], collapse = " "))
  inits <- given_to_initials(given_str)
  if (!nzchar(inits)) return(surname_str)
  paste(inits, surname_str)
}

split_top_level_and <- function(s) {
  chars <- strsplit(s, "")[[1]]
  n <- length(chars)
  if (n == 0) return(character(0))
  depth <- 0L
  out <- character(0)
  start <- 1L
  i <- 1L
  while (i <= n) {
    ch <- chars[i]
    if (ch == "{") {
      depth <- depth + 1L
    } else if (ch == "}") {
      depth <- max(0L, depth - 1L)
    } else if (depth == 0L && i >= 5L && i <= n) {
      tail_sub <- paste0(chars[i:n], collapse = "")
      if (grepl("^\\s+[Aa][Nn][Dd]\\s+", tail_sub)) {
        m <- regexpr("^\\s+[Aa][Nn][Dd]\\s+", tail_sub)
        mlen <- attr(m, "match.length")
        out <- c(out, paste0(chars[start:(i - 1L)], collapse = ""))
        i <- i + mlen
        start <- i
        next
      }
    }
    i <- i + 1L
  }
  out <- c(out, paste0(chars[start:n], collapse = ""))
  trimws(out)
}

parse_bibtex_authors <- function(auth_str) {
  parts <- split_top_level_and(clean_unicode_punct(auth_str))
  parsed <- vapply(parts, function(item) {
    item <- trimws(item)
    if (!nzchar(item)) return("")
    # Corporate / group author wrapped in braces e.g. {IOTA 6 Collaborators}
    if (grepl("^\\{[^}]+\\}$", item)) {
      return(trimws(gsub("[{}]", "", item)))
    }
    item <- gsub("[{}]", "", item)

    # BibLaTeX key=value format: family=Smeden, given=Maarten, prefix=van, useprefix=true
    if (grepl("family\\s*=", item, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      kv_parts <- trimws(strsplit(item, ",")[[1]])
      kv <- list()
      for (p in kv_parts) {
        eq_pos <- regexpr("=", p, fixed = TRUE)
        if (eq_pos > 0) {
          k <- tolower(trimws(substr(p, 1, eq_pos - 1)))
          v <- trimws(substr(p, eq_pos + 1, nchar(p)))
          kv[[k]] <- v
        }
      }
      fam <- format_surname(if (!is.null(kv$family)) kv$family else "")
      pfx <- if (!is.null(kv$prefix) && nzchar(kv$prefix)) kv$prefix else ""
      giv <- if (!is.null(kv$given)) kv$given else ""
      sur <- if (nzchar(pfx)) paste(pfx, fam) else fam
      inits <- given_to_initials(giv)
      return(trimws(paste(inits, sur)))
    }

    if (grepl(",", item, fixed = TRUE)) {
      comma_pos <- regexpr(",", item, fixed = TRUE)
      last  <- trimws(substr(item, 1, comma_pos - 1))
      first <- trimws(substr(item, comma_pos + 1, nchar(item)))
      # Zotero moves trailing surname particles after first name (e.g. "Calster, Ben Van", "Campo, Bavo De Cock")
      while (grepl("^(.+?)\\s+(De\\s+Cock|van\\s+der|van\\s+den|de\\s+la|Van|Von|De|Del|Den|Der)$",
                   first, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE)) {
        m <- regexec("^(.+?)\\s+(De\\s+Cock|van\\s+der|van\\s+den|de\\s+la|Van|Von|De|Del|Den|Der)$",
                     first, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE)
        caps <- regmatches(first, m)[[1]]
        first <- trimws(caps[2])
        last  <- paste(trimws(caps[3]), last)
      }
      inits <- given_to_initials(first)
      sur   <- format_surname(last)
      if (!nzchar(inits)) return(sur)
      return(paste(inits, sur))
    }

    parse_display_author(item)
  }, character(1))
  parsed <- parsed[nzchar(parsed)]
  paste(parsed, collapse = ", ")
}

# ── Local BibTeX author index (Layer 1) ───────────────────────────────────────
extract_bib_field <- function(block, field_name) {
  pat <- paste0("(?i)(?:^|\\n)\\s*", field_name, "\\s*=\\s*\\{")
  m <- regexpr(pat, block, perl = TRUE)
  if (m < 0) return(NA_character_)
  start_pos <- as.integer(m) + attr(m, "match.length")
  chars <- strsplit(substr(block, start_pos, nchar(block)), "")[[1]]
  depth <- 1L
  end_rel <- length(chars)
  for (k in seq_along(chars)) {
    if (chars[k] == "{") depth <- depth + 1L
    else if (chars[k] == "}") {
      depth <- depth - 1L
      if (depth == 0L) {
        end_rel <- k - 1L
        break
      }
    }
  }
  raw <- paste0(chars[seq_len(end_rel)], collapse = "")
  clean_unicode_punct(gsub("\\s+", " ", raw))
}

load_bibtex_lookup <- function(paths) {
  entries <- list()
  for (p in paths) {
    if (!file.exists(p)) next
    txt <- paste(readLines(p, encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
    starts <- gregexpr("(?m)^@", txt, perl = TRUE)[[1]]
    if (length(starts) == 1 && starts[1] == -1) next
    ends <- c(starts[-1] - 1L, nchar(txt))
    for (k in seq_along(starts)) {
      block <- substr(txt, starts[k], ends[k])
      ttl <- extract_bib_field(block, "title")
      aut <- extract_bib_field(block, "author")
      pub <- extract_bib_field(block, "publisher")
      if (is.na(ttl) || is.na(aut) || !nzchar(ttl) || !nzchar(aut)) next
      ttl_clean <- gsub("[{}]", "", ttl)
      ttl_norm  <- norm_title(ttl_clean)
      entries[[length(entries) + 1L]] <- list(
        title_norm = ttl_norm,
        tokens     = strsplit(ttl_norm, " ")[[1]],
        authors    = parse_bibtex_authors(aut),
        publisher  = if (is.na(pub)) "" else pub
      )
    }
  }
  entries
}

bib_entries <- load_bibtex_lookup(c(
  "../cv/peer_bib_auto.bib",
  "../cv/other_bib_auto.bib",
  "../cv/peer_bib.bib"
))

# ── OpenAlex ORCID & search index (Layer 2) ───────────────────────────────────
extract_openalex_record <- function(w) {
  wtype <- tolower(if (is.null(w$type)) "" else as.character(w$type))
  ttl <- if (is.null(w$title)) "" else as.character(w$title)
  if (wtype == "dataset") return(NULL)
  if (grepl("^(replication data|correction|erratum|corrigendum)\\b", ttl, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (is.null(w$authorships) || length(w$authorships) == 0) return(NULL)
  raw_names <- vapply(w$authorships, function(a) {
    if (is.null(a$author) || is.null(a$author$display_name)) "" else as.character(a$author$display_name)
  }, character(1))
  raw_names <- raw_names[nzchar(raw_names)]
  if (length(raw_names) == 0) return(NULL)
  fmt <- vapply(raw_names, parse_display_author, character(1))
  fmt_str <- paste(fmt[nzchar(fmt)], collapse = ", ")
  if (!str_detect(fmt_str, regex("barre[nñ]", ignore_case = TRUE))) return(NULL)
  ttl_norm <- norm_title(ttl)
  list(
    title_norm = ttl_norm,
    tokens     = strsplit(ttl_norm, " ")[[1]],
    authors    = fmt_str
  )
}

load_openalex_orcid <- function(orcid = "0000-0001-8020-0210") {
  old_to <- getOption("timeout")
  options(timeout = 12)
  on.exit(options(timeout = old_to), add = TRUE)
  url <- paste0(
    "https://api.openalex.org/works?filter=author.orcid:https://orcid.org/",
    orcid, "&per-page=100&mailto=lasai.barrenadataleb@kuleuven.be"
  )
  res <- tryCatch(fromJSON(url, simplifyVector = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(res) || is.null(res$results)) return(list())
  out <- lapply(res$results, extract_openalex_record)
  Filter(Negate(is.null), out)
}

search_openalex_title <- function(title_str) {
  old_to <- getOption("timeout")
  options(timeout = 8)
  on.exit(options(timeout = old_to), add = TRUE)
  url <- paste0(
    "https://api.openalex.org/works?search=",
    utils::URLencode(title_str, reserved = TRUE),
    "&per-page=5&mailto=lasai.barrenadataleb@kuleuven.be"
  )
  res <- tryCatch(fromJSON(url, simplifyVector = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(res) || is.null(res$results)) return(list())
  Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(res$results, extract_openalex_record))
}

best_record_match <- function(pub_tokens, records, min_sim = 0.70) {
  if (length(records) == 0) return(NULL)
  sims <- vapply(records, function(rec) jaccard_sim(pub_tokens, rec$tokens), numeric(1))
  best_idx <- which.max(sims)
  if (length(best_idx) == 1 && sims[best_idx] >= min_sim) {
    return(records[[best_idx]])
  }
  NULL
}

# ── Resolve complete author lists for truncated Scholar papers ────────────────
pubs$author_full <- clean_unicode_punct(pubs$author)
pubs$bib_publisher <- ""
trunc_idx <- grep("\\.\\.\\.", pubs$author_full)
oa_orcid_records <- if (length(trunc_idx) > 0) load_openalex_orcid() else list()

for (i in trunc_idx) {
  pub_tokens <- strsplit(norm_title(pubs$title[i]), " ")[[1]]
  resolved <- NA_character_

  # Layer 1: local BibTeX files
  m_bib <- best_record_match(pub_tokens, bib_entries, min_sim = 0.75)
  if (!is.null(m_bib)) {
    resolved <- m_bib$authors
    if (nzchar(m_bib$publisher)) pubs$bib_publisher[i] <- m_bib$publisher
  }

  # Layer 2a: OpenAlex ORCID works
  if (is.na(resolved)) {
    m_oa <- best_record_match(pub_tokens, oa_orcid_records, min_sim = 0.70)
    if (!is.null(m_oa)) resolved <- m_oa$authors
  }

  # Layer 2b: OpenAlex title search fallback
  if (is.na(resolved)) {
    oa_search_records <- search_openalex_title(pubs$title[i])
    m_oas <- best_record_match(pub_tokens, oa_search_records, min_sim = 0.75)
    if (!is.null(m_oas)) resolved <- m_oas$authors
  }

  # Layer 3: Google Scholar get_complete_authors fallback
  if (is.na(resolved)) {
    full <- tryCatch(
      get_complete_authors(id, pubs$pubid[i]),
      error = function(e) NA_character_
    )
    if (!is.na(full) && nchar(trimws(full)) > 0) resolved <- clean_unicode_punct(full)
    Sys.sleep(0.3)
  }

  if (!is.na(resolved) && nzchar(resolved)) {
    pubs$author_full[i] <- resolved
  }
}

# Drop entries where Lasai is not an author (e.g., award announcements about Lasai)
authored_mask <- str_detect(pubs$author_full, regex("barre[nñ]", ignore_case = TRUE))
pubs <- pubs[authored_mask, ]

# ── Publication deduplication ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Google Scholar sometimes indexes both a preprint and its published version.
# We detect these by computing Jaccard title similarity between each
# preprint/working-paper and every published paper, then dropping the preprint
# when a close match (≥ 0.28) exists.

title_tokens <- strsplit(sapply(pubs$title, norm_title), " ")

preprint_pat <- regex(
  "arxiv|biorxiv|medrxiv|zenodo|preprint|working paper|statistics spain",
  ignore_case = TRUE
)
venue_src <- ifelse(
  nzchar(trimws(pubs$journal)),
  pubs$journal,
  pubs$bib_publisher
)
is_preprint   <- str_detect(venue_src, preprint_pat)
published_idx <- which(!is_preprint)
preprint_idx  <- which(is_preprint)

# Drop any preprint whose best title match with a published paper is ≥ 0.28
drop_rows <- unlist(Filter(function(i) {
  if (length(published_idx) == 0) return(FALSE)
  sims <- sapply(published_idx, function(j) jaccard_sim(title_tokens[[i]], title_tokens[[j]]))
  max(sims, na.rm = TRUE) >= 0.28
}, preprint_idx))

keep_idx <- which(!seq_len(nrow(pubs)) %in% drop_rows)
clean_pubs <- pubs[keep_idx, ]
clean_is_preprint <- is_preprint[keep_idx]

# Sort clean_pubs consistently (year desc, cites desc) before building lists
yr_order <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(clean_pubs$year))
yr_order[is.na(yr_order)] <- -1L
ct_order <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(clean_pubs$cites))
ct_order[is.na(ct_order)] <- 0L
ord <- order(-yr_order, -ct_order)
clean_pubs        <- clean_pubs[ord, ]
clean_is_preprint <- clean_is_preprint[ord]

# ── Name deduplication ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
manual_corrections <- c(
  "G Collins"        = "GS Collins",
  "JF Calatrava"     = "J Fernández Calatrava",
  "JCGS de Cueto"    = "JC Gálvez Sainz de Cueto",
  "JYJ Verbakel"     = "JY Verbakel",
  "BV Calster"       = "B Van Calster",
  "BD Moor"          = "B De Moor",
  "BDC Campo"        = "B De Cock Campo",
  "B De Cock"        = "B De Cock Campo",
  "TH Bourne"        = "T Bourne",
  "RR Zegarra"       = "R Ramirez Zegarra",
  "Rén Armañanzas"   = "R Armañanzas"
)

clean_coauthor_tokens <- function(auth_str) {
  toks <- auth_str |>
    str_split(",\\s*") |>
    unlist() |>
    clean_unicode_punct()
  toks <- toks[!str_detect(toks, regex("barre[nñ]", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  toks <- toks[!str_detect(toks, regex("collaborators|consortium|group|committee", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  toks <- toks[!str_detect(toks, "^\\.+$|^…$")]
  toks <- toks[nchar(toks) > 1]
  ifelse(toks %in% names(manual_corrections), manual_corrections[toks], toks)
}

paper_raw_coauthors <- lapply(clean_pubs$author_full, clean_coauthor_tokens)

# Stage 1: Group accent/case variants; prefer accented & properly cased form
all_surfaces <- unlist(paper_raw_coauthors)
pick_best_surface <- function(cands, freq_tbl) {
  has_accent <- grepl("[^\\x01-\\x7F]", cands, perl = TRUE)
  init_len   <- ifelse(grepl("^[A-Z]+\\s+", cands), nchar(sub("^([A-Z]+)\\s+.*$", "\\1", cands)), 0L)
  freqs      <- as.integer(freq_tbl[cands])
  freqs[is.na(freqs)] <- 0L
  cands[order(-as.integer(has_accent), -init_len, -freqs, cands)][1]
}

surf_freq <- table(all_surfaces)
stage1_keys <- safe_ascii_lower(names(surf_freq))
stage1_groups <- split(names(surf_freq), stage1_keys)
stage1_rep <- vapply(stage1_groups, pick_best_surface, character(1), freq_tbl = surf_freq)
s1_lookup <- setNames(stage1_rep[stage1_keys], names(surf_freq))

paper_s1 <- lapply(paper_raw_coauthors, function(x) unique(unname(s1_lookup[x])))

# Stage 2: Merge unambiguous initial-prefix variants (e.g. A Vickers -> AJ Vickers, E Steyerberg -> EW Steyerberg)
# strictly ONLY when the two forms share the exact surname and never co-occur on the same paper.
s1_freq <- table(unlist(paper_s1))
u_s1 <- names(s1_freq)
s2_lookup <- setNames(u_s1, u_s1)

if (length(u_s1) > 1) {
  inits_vec <- ifelse(grepl("^[A-Z]+\\s+", u_s1), sub("^([A-Z]+)\\s+.*$", "\\1", u_s1), "")
  surs_vec  <- ifelse(nzchar(inits_vec), safe_ascii_lower(sub("^[A-Z]+\\s+", "", u_s1)), "")

  cooccur_pair <- function(a, b) {
    any(vapply(paper_s1, function(pa) (a %in% pa) && (b %in% pa), logical(1)))
  }

  for (sur in unique(surs_vec[nzchar(surs_vec)])) {
    idx <- which(surs_vec == sur)
    if (length(idx) < 2) next
    cands <- u_s1[idx]
    cinits <- inits_vec[idx]
    # Order shorter initials first
    o <- order(nchar(cinits), cinits)
    cands <- cands[o]
    cinits <- cinits[o]
    for (a_i in seq_along(cands)) {
      sh <- cands[a_i]
      si <- cinits[a_i]
      ext_idx <- which(
        nchar(cinits) > nchar(si) &
        startsWith(cinits, si) &
        vapply(cands, function(lg) !cooccur_pair(sh, lg), logical(1))
      )
      if (length(ext_idx) == 1) {
        s2_lookup[sh] <- cands[ext_idx]
      }
    }
  }
  # Resolve any transitive chains
  for (step in seq_len(3)) s2_lookup <- setNames(s2_lookup[s2_lookup], names(s2_lookup))
}

paper_coauthors <- lapply(paper_s1, function(x) {
  mapped <- unique(unname(s2_lookup[x]))
  mapped[!is.na(mapped) & nzchar(mapped)]
})

# ── Build nodes and links ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
canonical_names <- unlist(paper_coauthors)
coauthors <- sort(table(canonical_names), decreasing = TRUE) |>
  as.data.frame(stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  setNames(c("id", "n_papers")) |>
  mutate(n_papers = as.integer(n_papers)) |>
  filter(n_papers >= 2)

# Cluster co-authors by shared papers so communities sit together around the circle
if (nrow(coauthors) >= 3) {
  inc_mat <- vapply(seq_along(paper_coauthors), function(j) {
    as.integer(coauthors$id %in% paper_coauthors[[j]])
  }, integer(nrow(coauthors)))
  hc <- stats::hclust(stats::dist(inc_mat, method = "binary"), method = "average")
  coauthors$order_idx <- match(seq_len(nrow(coauthors)), hc$order) - 1L
} else {
  coauthors$order_idx <- seq_len(nrow(coauthors)) - 1L
}

nodes <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(id = "Lasai Barreñada", group = "self",     n_papers = NA_integer_, order_idx = NA_integer_, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(id = coauthors$id,      group = "coauthor", n_papers = coauthors$n_papers, order_idx = coauthors$order_idx, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
)

links <- data.frame(
  source = "Lasai Barreñada",
  target = coauthors$id,
  value  = coauthors$n_papers,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ── Build full publication metadata list ────────────────────────────────────
all_pubs_list <- vector("list", nrow(clean_pubs))

get_col_val <- function(df, col, i, default = "") {
  if (!col %in% names(df)) return(default)
  v <- df[[col]][i]
  if (is.null(v) || is.na(v)) return(default)
  v
}

format_venue <- function(jrn, num, bib_pub = "") {
  jrn <- clean_unicode_punct(as.character(jrn))
  num <- clean_unicode_punct(as.character(num))
  bib_pub <- clean_unicode_punct(as.character(bib_pub))
  if (!nzchar(jrn) && nzchar(bib_pub)) return(bib_pub)
  if (grepl("^arXiv", jrn, ignore.case = TRUE) && grepl("^:?\\d{4}\\.\\d+", num)) {
    arxiv_id <- sub("^:", "", num)
    return(paste0("arXiv:", arxiv_id))
  }
  if (grepl("^medRxiv$", jrn, ignore.case = TRUE) && nzchar(num)) {
    num <- gsub("\\.\\s+", ".", num)
    return(paste0("medRxiv, ", num))
  }
  if (nzchar(jrn) && nzchar(num)) paste0(jrn, ", ", num) else jrn
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(clean_pubs))) {
  canonical_authors <- paper_coauthors[[i]]

  scholar_url <- paste0(
    "https://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=view_citation&hl=en&user=",
    id, "&citation_for_view=", id, ":", clean_pubs$pubid[i]
  )

  yr_raw <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(get_col_val(clean_pubs, "year", i, NA_integer_)))
  ct_raw <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(get_col_val(clean_pubs, "cites", i, 0L)))
  if (is.na(ct_raw)) ct_raw <- 0L
  jrn     <- get_col_val(clean_pubs, "journal", i, "")
  num     <- get_col_val(clean_pubs, "number", i, "")
  bib_pub <- get_col_val(clean_pubs, "bib_publisher", i, "")
  venue_str <- format_venue(jrn, num, bib_pub)

  all_pubs_list[[i]] <- list(
    title       = as.character(get_col_val(clean_pubs, "title", i, "")),
    authors     = as.character(get_col_val(clean_pubs, "author_full", i, "")),
    venue       = venue_str,
    year        = yr_raw,
    cites       = ct_raw,
    is_preprint = isTRUE(clean_is_preprint[i]),
    url         = scholar_url,
    coauthors   = as.list(as.character(canonical_authors))
  )
}

cat(sprintf(
  "<script>\nconst graphNodes = %s;\nconst graphLinks = %s;\nconst allPublications = %s;\n</script>",
  toJSON(nodes,         auto_unbox = TRUE),
  toJSON(links,         auto_unbox = TRUE),
  toJSON(all_pubs_list, auto_unbox = TRUE)
))
```

```{=html}
  </style>
  <h2 style="margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">All publications</h2>

      <span class="pub-sort-label">Sort:</span>
      <button type="button" class="pub-sort-btn active" data-sort="year">Year</button>
      <button type="button" class="pub-sort-btn" data-sort="cites">Citations</button>
    </div>
    <span id="pub-filter-pill" class="pub-filter-pill" style="display:none;">
      Filtered by: <strong id="pub-filter-name"></strong>
      <button type="button" id="pub-filter-clear" aria-label="Clear co-author filter">×</button>
    </span>
    <span id="pub-count" class="pub-count"></span>
  </div>
  <div id="pub-full-list"></div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7/dist/d3.min.js"></script>

<script>
(function () {
  const W = 860, H = 600;
  const DIM_OPACITY = 0.12;
  const FOCUS_MS = 300;

  const container = document.getElementById("graph-container");
  const tooltip   = d3.select("#graph-tooltip");

  const svg = d3.select("#coauthor-graph")
    .append("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`)
    .attr("width", "100%")
    .style("background", "#f4f8fd")
    .style("border-radius", "8px");

  // ── SVG Defs: radial gradients + filters ──────────────────────────────
  const defs = svg.append("defs");

  // Drop shadow for coauthor nodes
  const shadow = defs.append("filter")
    .attr("id", "node-shadow")
    .attr("x", "-40%").attr("y", "-40%")
    .attr("width", "180%").attr("height", "180%");
  shadow.append("feDropShadow")
    .attr("dx", 0).attr("dy", 1)
    .attr("stdDeviation", 3)
    .attr("flood-color", "rgba(0,0,0,0.18)");

  // Glow filter for centre node
  const glow = defs.append("filter")
    .attr("id", "center-glow")
    .attr("x", "-50%").attr("y", "-50%")
    .attr("width", "200%").attr("height", "200%");
  glow.append("feGaussianBlur")
    .attr("in", "SourceGraphic")
    .attr("stdDeviation", 4)
    .attr("result", "blur");
  glow.append("feMerge")
    .selectAll("feMergeNode")
    .data(["blur", "SourceGraphic"])
    .join("feMergeNode")
    .attr("in", d => d);

  // ── Scales ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const coauthorNodes = graphNodes.filter(d => d.group !== "self");
  const minP = d3.min(coauthorNodes, d => d.n_papers) || 2;
  const maxP = d3.max(coauthorNodes, d => d.n_papers) || minP;
  const domainMax = maxP === minP ? minP + 1 : maxP;

  const colorScale = d3.scaleLinear()
    .domain([minP, domainMax])
    .range(["#93c4e8", "#1a6eaa"]);

  const rScale = d3.scaleSqrt()
    .domain([minP, domainMax])
    .range([8, 22]);

  const distScale = maxP === minP
    ? () => 165
    : d3.scaleSqrt().domain([minP, maxP]).range([225, 92]);

  const CENTER_R = 32;

  function surname(name) {
    return name.replace(/^[A-Z.]+\s+/, "");
  }

  // ── Data & angular sector initialization ──────────────────────────────
  const nodes = graphNodes.map(d => ({ ...d }));
  const links = graphLinks.map(d => ({ ...d }));
  const coCount = coauthorNodes.length || 1;

  nodes.forEach((d, i) => {
    if (d.group === "self") {
      d.fx = W / 2;
      d.fy = H / 2;
    } else {
      const slot = Number.isFinite(d.order_idx) ? d.order_idx : i;
      const angle = (2 * Math.PI * slot) / coCount - Math.PI / 2;
      const r0 = distScale(d.n_papers);
      d.x = W / 2 + Math.cos(angle) * r0;
      d.y = H / 2 + Math.sin(angle) * r0;
    }
  });

  // Create a radial gradient per node (lighter centre → base colour edge)
  nodes.forEach((d, i) => {
    const base = d.group === "self" ? "#007BFF" : colorScale(d.n_papers);
    const light = d3.color(base).brighter(0.6).formatHex();
    const grad = defs.append("radialGradient")
      .attr("id", `node-grad-${i}`)
      .attr("cx", "35%").attr("cy", "35%").attr("r", "65%");
    grad.append("stop").attr("offset", "0%").attr("stop-color", light);
    grad.append("stop").attr("offset", "100%").attr("stop-color", base);
  });

  // ── Simulation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const sim = d3.forceSimulation(nodes)
    .force("link",      d3.forceLink(links).id(d => d.id)
                          .distance(d => distScale(d.value)))
    .force("charge",    d3.forceManyBody().strength(-260))
    .force("x",         d3.forceX(W / 2).strength(0.035))
    .force("y",         d3.forceY(H / 2).strength(0.055))
    .force("collision", d3.forceCollide(d =>
      d.group === "self" ? CENTER_R + 18 : rScale(d.n_papers) + 22));

  // ── Selection / focus state ───────────────────────────────────────────
  let selectedNode = null;
  let mouseDownXY  = null;

  function getConnected(d) {
    const ids = new Set([d.id]);
    links.forEach(l => {
      const s = typeof l.source === "object" ? l.source.id : l.source;
      const t = typeof l.target === "object" ? l.target.id : l.target;
      if (s === d.id) ids.add(t);
      if (t === d.id) ids.add(s);
    });
    return ids;
  }

  function applyFocus(focusNode) {
    const conn = getConnected(focusNode);
    nodeSel.transition().duration(FOCUS_MS)
      .style("opacity", n => conn.has(n.id) ? 1 : DIM_OPACITY);
    linkSel.transition().duration(FOCUS_MS)
      .style("opacity", l => {
        const s = typeof l.source === "object" ? l.source.id : l.source;
        const t = typeof l.target === "object" ? l.target.id : l.target;
        return (s === focusNode.id || t === focusNode.id) ? 0.75 : DIM_OPACITY;
      });
    labelSel.transition().duration(FOCUS_MS)
      .style("opacity", n => conn.has(n.id) ? 1 : DIM_OPACITY);
  }

  function restoreFull() {
    nodeSel.transition().duration(FOCUS_MS).style("opacity", 1);
    linkSel.transition().duration(FOCUS_MS).style("opacity", 0.75);
    labelSel.transition().duration(FOCUS_MS).style("opacity", 1);
  }

  let activeAuthorFilter = null;
  let currentSort = "year";

  function escapeHtml(str) {
    if (!str) return "";
    return String(str)
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
      .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
      .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
      .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
  }

  function highlightSelf(authorsStr) {
    const safe = escapeHtml(authorsStr || "");
    return safe.replace(/([^,]*Barre(?:ñ|n|&ntilde;)ada[^,]*)/gi, "<strong>$1</strong>");
  }

  function renderPubItem(p, includeYear) {
    const venueHtml = p.venue ? `<span class="pub-venue">${escapeHtml(p.venue)}</span>` : "";
    const yearHtml = includeYear && p.year ? `<span class="pub-badge-year">${escapeHtml(String(p.year))}</span>` : "";
    const preprintHtml = p.is_preprint ? '<span class="pub-badge-preprint">Preprint</span>' : "";
    const citesHtml = p.cites > 0 ? `<span class="pub-badge-cites">Cited by ${p.cites}</span>` : "";
    return `<div class="pub-item">
      <div class="pub-item-title"><a href="${escapeHtml(p.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${escapeHtml(p.title)}</a></div>
      <div class="pub-item-authors">${highlightSelf(p.authors)}</div>
      <div class="pub-item-meta">${venueHtml}${yearHtml}${preprintHtml}${citesHtml}</div>
    </div>`;
  }

  function renderPubList() {
    const listEl = document.getElementById("pub-full-list");
    const countEl = document.getElementById("pub-count");
    const pillEl = document.getElementById("pub-filter-pill");
    const pillNameEl = document.getElementById("pub-filter-name");
    const searchInput = document.getElementById("pub-search");
    if (!listEl || typeof allPublications === "undefined") return;

    const q = (searchInput ? searchInput.value : "").trim().toLowerCase();

    if (activeAuthorFilter) {
      pillNameEl.textContent = activeAuthorFilter;
      pillEl.style.display = "inline-flex";
    } else {
      pillEl.style.display = "none";
    }

    const filtered = allPublications.filter(p => {
      if (activeAuthorFilter) {
        const co = Array.isArray(p.coauthors) ? p.coauthors : (p.coauthors ? [p.coauthors] : []);
        if (!co.includes(activeAuthorFilter)) return false;
      }
      if (q) {
        const hay = ((p.title || "") + " " + (p.authors || "") + " " + (p.venue || "") + " " + (p.year || "")).toLowerCase();
        if (!hay.includes(q)) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });

    filtered.sort((a, b) => {
      if (currentSort === "cites") {
        return ((b.cites || 0) - (a.cites || 0)) || ((b.year || 0) - (a.year || 0));
      }
      return ((b.year || 0) - (a.year || 0)) || ((b.cites || 0) - (a.cites || 0));
    });

    countEl.textContent = `Showing ${filtered.length} of ${allPublications.length} publications`;

    if (filtered.length === 0) {
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#6c757d; font-style:italic;">No matching publications found.</p>';
      return;
    }

    let html = "";
    if (currentSort === "cites") {
      html = filtered.map(p => renderPubItem(p, true)).join("");
    } else {
      const byYear = new Map();
      filtered.forEach(p => {
        const yrKey = p.year ? String(p.year) : "Other";
        if (!byYear.has(yrKey)) byYear.set(yrKey, []);
        byYear.get(yrKey).push(p);
      });

      byYear.forEach((papers, yrKey) => {
        html += `<div class="pub-year-heading">${escapeHtml(yrKey)}</div>`;
        html += papers.map(p => renderPubItem(p, false)).join("");
      });
    }

    listEl.innerHTML = html;
  }

  document.getElementById("pub-search")?.addEventListener("input", renderPubList);
  document.querySelectorAll(".pub-sort-btn").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const sortMode = btn.getAttribute("data-sort") || "year";
      if (sortMode === currentSort) return;
      currentSort = sortMode;
      document.querySelectorAll(".pub-sort-btn").forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn));
      renderPubList();
    });
  });
  document.getElementById("pub-filter-clear")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
    clearSelection();
  });

  function clearSelection() {
    if (selectedNode) {
      nodeSel.filter(n => n.id === selectedNode.id)
        .attr("stroke", "#fff").attr("stroke-width", 2);
      selectedNode = null;
    }
    activeAuthorFilter = null;
    restoreFull();
    renderPubList();
  }

  // ── Links (curved paths) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  const linkSel = svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(links)
    .join("path")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", "#c4d8ed")
      .attr("stroke-width", d => Math.sqrt(d.value) * 1.8)
      .style("opacity", 0);

  function linkPath(d, i) {
    const sx = d.source.x, sy = d.source.y;
    const tx = d.target.x, ty = d.target.y;
    const dx = tx - sx, dy = ty - sy;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
    const sign = i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1;
    const off  = dist * 0.1 * sign;
    const mx = (sx + tx) / 2 + (-dy / dist) * off;
    const my = (sy + ty) / 2 + ( dx / dist) * off;
    return `M ${sx},${sy} Q ${mx},${my} ${tx},${ty}`;
  }

  // ── Nodes (visual) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const nodeSel = svg.append("g")
    .attr("pointer-events", "none")
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(nodes)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("r", 0)
      .attr("fill",         (d, i) => `url(#node-grad-${i})`)
      .attr("stroke",       "#fff")
      .attr("stroke-width", 2)
      .attr("filter", d => d.group === "self" ? "url(#center-glow)" : "url(#node-shadow)");

  // ── Invisible hit targets for mobile touch accessibility ──────────────
  const hitSel = svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(nodes)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("r", d => d.group === "self" ? CENTER_R + 6 : Math.max(20, rScale(d.n_papers) + 8))
      .attr("fill", "transparent")
      .style("cursor", "pointer")
    .on("mouseover", function (event, d) {
      if (selectedNode && selectedNode.id === d.id) return;
      nodeSel.filter(n => n.id === d.id)
        .attr("stroke", "#ffcc00").attr("stroke-width", 3);
      if (!selectedNode) applyFocus(d);
      const [x, y] = d3.pointer(event, container);
      if (d.group === "self") {
        tooltip.html(`<strong>Lasai Barreñada</strong><br/><em style="color:#888;font-size:11px">Click to show all publications</em>`);
      } else {
        tooltip.html(`<strong>${d.id}</strong><br/>
                 ${d.n_papers} shared publication${d.n_papers > 1 ? "s" : ""}<br/>
                 <em style="color:#888;font-size:11px">Click to filter publications below</em>`);
      }
      const cw = container.clientWidth || W;
      const ch = container.clientHeight || H;
      const tw = tooltip.node().offsetWidth || 180;
      const th = tooltip.node().offsetHeight || 60;
      const left = Math.max(8, Math.min(cw - tw - 8, x + 14));
      const top  = Math.max(8, Math.min(ch - th - 8, y - 52));
      tooltip
        .style("opacity", 1)
        .style("left", left + "px")
        .style("top",  top + "px");
    })
    .on("mouseout", function (event, d) {
      tooltip.style("opacity", 0);
      if (selectedNode && selectedNode.id === d.id) return;
      nodeSel.filter(n => n.id === d.id)
        .attr("stroke", "#fff").attr("stroke-width", 2);
      if (selectedNode) applyFocus(selectedNode);
      else restoreFull();
    })
    .on("mousedown.clicktrack", (event) => {
      mouseDownXY = [event.clientX, event.clientY];
    })
    .on("click", function (event, d) {
      if (mouseDownXY) {
        const moved = Math.hypot(
          event.clientX - mouseDownXY[0],
          event.clientY - mouseDownXY[1]
        );
        mouseDownXY = null;
        if (moved > 5) return;
      }
      event.stopPropagation();

      if (d.group === "self") {
        clearSelection();
        document.getElementById("pub-list-section")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "nearest" });
        return;
      }

      if (selectedNode && selectedNode.id === d.id) { clearSelection(); return; }

      if (selectedNode) {
        nodeSel.filter(n => n.id === selectedNode.id)
          .attr("stroke", "#fff").attr("stroke-width", 2);
      }

      selectedNode = d;
      nodeSel.filter(n => n.id === d.id)
        .attr("stroke", "#ffcc00").attr("stroke-width", 3);
      activeAuthorFilter = d.id;
      applyFocus(d);
      renderPubList();
      document.getElementById("pub-list-section")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "nearest" });
    })
    .call(drag(sim));

  svg.on("click", () => clearSelection());

  // ── Labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const labelSel = svg.append("g")
    .attr("pointer-events", "none")
    .selectAll("text")
    .data(nodes)
    .join("text")
      .text(d => d.group === "self" ? "Lasai" : surname(d.id))
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .attr("font-size",   d => d.group === "self" ? "13px" : "10px")
      .attr("font-weight", d => d.group === "self" ? "bold" : "normal")
      .attr("fill",        d => d.group === "self" ? "#fff" : "#333")
      .style("paint-order",     "stroke")
      .style("stroke",          d => d.group === "self" ? "none" : "#f4f8fd")
      .style("stroke-width",    d => d.group === "self" ? "0px" : "3px")
      .style("stroke-linejoin", "round")
      .style("opacity", 0);

  // ── Tick ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const padX = 56, padTop = 30, padBottom = 28;
  sim.on("tick", () => {
    nodes.forEach(d => {
      if (d.group !== "self") {
        const r = rScale(d.n_papers);
        d.x = Math.max(padX + r, Math.min(W - padX - r, d.x));
        d.y = Math.max(padTop + r, Math.min(H - padBottom - r, d.y));
      }
    });
    linkSel.attr("d", linkPath);
    nodeSel
      .attr("cx", d => d.x)
      .attr("cy", d => d.y);
    hitSel
      .attr("cx", d => d.x)
      .attr("cy", d => d.y);
    labelSel
      .attr("x", d => d.x)
      .attr("y", d => d.group === "self"
        ? d.y + 4.5
        : d.y - rScale(d.n_papers) - 4);
  });

  // Render initial full publication list
  renderPubList();

  // ── Entrance animation ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  setTimeout(() => {
    linkSel.transition().duration(600).ease(d3.easeCubicOut)
      .style("opacity", 0.75);
    nodeSel.transition().duration(700).ease(d3.easeBackOut.overshoot(0.6))
      .attr("r", d => d.group === "self" ? CENTER_R : rScale(d.n_papers));
    labelSel.transition().duration(700).delay(200).ease(d3.easeCubicOut)
      .style("opacity", 1);
  }, 400);

  // ── Drag ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function drag(simulation) {
    return d3.drag()
      .on("start", (event, d) => {
        if (!event.active) simulation.alphaTarget(0.3).restart();
        if (d.group !== "self") { d.fx = d.x; d.fy = d.y; }
      })
      .on("drag", (event, d) => {
        if (d.group !== "self") { d.fx = event.x; d.fy = event.y; }
      })
      .on("end", (event, d) => {
        if (!event.active) simulation.alphaTarget(0);
        if (d.group !== "self") { d.fx = null; d.fy = null; }
      });
  }

  // ── Legend ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(14, ${H - 80})`);

  legend.append("rect")
    .attr("width", 168).attr("height", 68).attr("rx", 5)
    .attr("fill", "#fff").attr("fill-opacity", 0.9);

  const minR = rScale(minP);
  const maxR = Math.min(15, rScale(maxP));

  legend.append("circle").attr("cx", 20).attr("cy", 20).attr("r", minR)
    .attr("fill", colorScale(minP));
  legend.append("text").attr("x", 40).attr("y", 24)
    .text(`${minP} shared papers`).attr("font-size", "11px").attr("fill", "#444");

  legend.append("circle").attr("cx", 20).attr("cy", 48).attr("r", maxR)
    .attr("fill", colorScale(maxP));
  legend.append("text").attr("x", 40).attr("y", 52)
    .text(`${maxP} shared papers`).attr("font-size", "11px").attr("fill", "#444");

  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", W - 10).attr("y", H - 10)
    .attr("text-anchor", "end")
    .attr("font-size", "11px").attr("fill", "#aaa")
    .text("Drag to rearrange · click any node to filter publications below");
})();
</script>
```
